prompt:
Clean HD painterly chibi 2D RPG animation sheet, NOT pixel art.
Image 1 is HIRO's approved new look for this form: copy his face, messy brown hair, brown eyes, green scarf, outfit, boots and sword EXACTLY from Image 1 (plain, humble, muted earthy colours, no gold, no gems, no glow).
Image 2 is his current "cast" animation sheet: copy EXACTLY its layout (3 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, landscape 1536x1024, read left to right then the next row), the number of frames, EVERY pose, the position and angle of every limb and of the sword, the body size and position inside every cell and the foot line. Redraw each frame of Image 2 with the look of Image 1; change nothing about the motion.
Remove every effect that Image 2 may contain: no glow, no sparkles, no flames, no slash trails, no light, no particles, no aura. Body and sword only.
Nothing crosses a cell edge. Uniform pure flat #FF00FF magenta background, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no floor, no shadows.

precheck.summary: The candidate has the requested 3x2 grid of six frames on a flat magenta background, with no text, borders, or visible effects. The poses match Reference 2 (idle with sword, raised fist, two open-hand waves, fist), and the character's hair, green scarf, outfit, boots and sword are consistent with Reference 1. No cut-off limbs or anatomy errors are visible. The only uncertainty is the exact pixel size, which I cannot verify, but the aspect ratio is close to the requested landscape format.
